title: CTK-01 Capability Trigger Kernel
purpose: Prove one trusted contextual event can select, plan, execute, validate, and durably record one versioned local capability on one NearbyNode boundary.
problem: Locaily has tracks, tools, validation, evidence, and relay primitives, but lacks the deterministic event-to-capability runtime contract connecting them.

included: One configured local NearbyNode execution boundary
Event, capability manifest, execution plan, output, and run record contracts
Filesystem capability registry and exact trigger matching
Policy, eligibility, approval, handler availability, and version checks
Deterministic rule/script/tool executor with a disabled model port
Append-only durable run records with complete provenance
Standalone CLI, acceptance tests, architecture notes, and run documentation
excluded: Production UI or companion server endpoint
Distributed node scheduling or remote relay execution
Model benchmarking, model selection, or cloud fallback
Automatic capability discovery, generation, promotion, or self-modification
Lighthouse Handoff or DBVT SEO Audit product integration

acceptanceCriteria.description: A trusted project.status.changed fixture completes status-handoff with valid output, legal transitions, hashes, and a durable run record.

evidence.note: Valid activation, transitions, hashes, output validation, and record persistence passed.
Live reference fixture run completed and persisted.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Malformed, untrusted, irrelevant, unknown, incompatible, unavailable, policy-blocked, and approval-required paths stop explicitly before unauthorized execution.

evidence.note: All required rejection, ignore, approval, and failure paths passed with zero unauthorized handler calls.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Identical event and manifest inputs produce the same plan hash and duplicate submission cannot execute twice.

evidence.note: Deterministic plan hash and duplicate idempotency checks passed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Accepted and failed executions persist reproducible event, node, policy, manifest, plan, attempts, validations, output, and terminal-state evidence without secrets.

evidence.note: Run-record schema, completed and failed persistence, version provenance, and secret redaction passed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The reference slice performs no network or cloud fallback calls.

evidence.note: Network spy observed zero calls and the recorded policy disables network and cloud fallback.

acceptanceCriteria.description: CTK acceptance coverage and relevant repository validation commands pass.

evidence.note: Full offline repository suite passed after the shared validator change.
